note: TestRFC7296ChildRekeyResponseCarriesTheSelectorsAndMayNarrow: ze's respondChildRekey response announces TSi/TSr equal to the installed scope, and ze as rekey initiator installs an answer narrowed to 10.1.0.0/25 from a /24 proposal (the may-be-a-subset clause). TestChildRekeyAnswerWithoutTrafficSelectorsIsRefused (moved from 2.9-1): a response without TS payloads is refused and installs nothing, the same fixture with both payloads installs their scope.
